Body.Content:
We are announcing evaluation for automation flows in Copilot Studio. This feature reached general availability on October 15, 2026.

How does this affect me?
This feature enables you to evaluate automation quality with the same structured approach used for agent evaluations, reducing reliance on manual testing and trace inspection. This improves confidence in AI-driven automation and makes it easier to detect quality issues before they affect production scenarios.

What action do I need to take?
This message is for awareness, and no action is required.

message.Title: Copilot Studio - Evaluation for automation flows
